description: This file is a shell script that sets up and runs tests for Git hooks, specifically 'pre-receive' and 'post-receive' hooks, using various protocols including local and HTTP. It defines setup functions, test execution functions, and runs the tests in different environments.

methods.name: setup_upstream_and_workbench
methods.description: Sets up upstream and workbench git repositories with initial commits, tags, remotes, and hooks.

methods.name: run_proc_receive_hook_test
methods.description: Runs tests for the git 'proc-receive' hook over different protocols (local and HTTP).
